## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` reports no issues and `flutter test` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, written first
- [ ] Works with reduced motion, large text and a screen reader (UI changes)
- [ ] Screenshots in light and dark (UI changes)
- [ ] No secrets, personal addresses or real server names in the diff
- [ ] No new network endpoint, permission or tracking; or the privacy policy and `docs/release.md` are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased, if a user would notice
